ideas.pitch: A Python-based cryptographic analysis toolkit tailored for CTF cipher challenges, featuring automated frequency analysis, RSA key recovery scripts, and hash identification.

ideas.title: CryptoFlag Automator

ideas.pitch: A local static analysis wrapper for binary exploitation challenges that flags common memory corruption vulnerabilities like buffer overflows and format string bugs.

ideas.title: BinaryAuditor AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuine technical depth by combining security analysis workflows with quick tooling, mirroring winning developer tool patterns.
